text_block_list.text:
Back then, I felt the exact same way— 
"I want to learn more about horsegirls."

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"Look, look! These earrings look gorgeous 
even at night♪" 
"Hey, who's handling the dedicatory dance 
this year?" 
"Ooh, I really wanna grab some grilled 
carrots!"
choice_data_list: So this is the Shuntaisai venue...!
So this is the Shuntaisai venue...!

text_block_list.text:
The Shuntaisai. 
A festival "of the horsegirls, by the 
horsegirls, and for the horsegirls."

Perhaps because of that, there were 
horsegirls wherever I looked. 
—As an aspiring Trainer back then, 
I was completely overwhelmed by the 
unfamiliar spectacle.

"Horsegirls." They possess unique ears and 
tails, 
as well as bodies capable of running at 
extraordinary speeds.

When they first appeared, 
and when they began living alongside 
humans— 
much of that history remains shrouded in 
mystery.
*(THUD!!)*

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
O Three Goddesses, most revered and 
sacred. 
Did the sound of my strides reach the 
heavens?

Living their lives fueled by the singular 
desire to run, 
they seemed so dazzlingly radiant to me.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...With this single arrow, I shall forge a 
path.

Performing sacred rites in devotion to 
that earnest wish, 
they appeared awe-inspiringly sacred.

Even if the weight of the wish poured into 
it, 
and the true significance of this 
festival, 
were things beyond human comprehension...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Unto you, I dedicate my wish.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To you who ran before, you who run beside, 
and you who run beyond.

Even if I could not truly take part in 
that prayer... 
Seeing their earnest, unyielding devotion 
...sparked a deeply personal wish within 
me.
choice_data_list:
(May her wish come true, wherever it may 
lead.)

text_block_list.text:
"Horsegirls." 
Blessed with their ears, tails, and 
extraordinary strength, 
they carry unique wishes and dreams.

I wanted to stand by their side. 
I wanted to become their strength.

—That was the prayer I held, simply as a 
human.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
And so, in the Year of the Horsegirl... 
basically the Year of the Horse, 
we hold a very special Shuntaisai!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! Wait, the Year of the 
Horse... 
Isn't that in two years?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yup! But my grandma and grandpa back home 
are already raring to go! Apparently—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: "Lady Azuma has made her appearance."

On this day, I had been summoned to the 
director's office 
along with my trainee.

Looking around the room, 
several other horsegirls had gathered as 
well.

The honors student striving to be number 
one, Daiwa Scarlet. 
The pure-hearted girl from Morioka, Yukino 
Bijin.

The Sengoku warlord aiming to conquer the 
realm, No Reason. 
The people-loving horsegirl, Blast 
Onepiece.

And the delightfully innocent prodigy, 
Mayano Top Gun, too......
*(Chime...)*

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, she has arrived. 
Silence, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*... Allow me to make introductions. 
She is—

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Lady Azuma."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...It is an honor to make your 
acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
My name is Azuma. 
Priestess of the horsegirl rites, the 
Shuntaisai. 
And one who comes seeking your strength.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: The request I humbly bring before you all—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Concerns the festival held once every 
twelve years: 
the "Goshiki Shuntaisai."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The Goshiki Shuntaisai?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There may be those among you hearing of it 
for the first time. 
...After all, it is an occasion celebrated 
only once every twelve years.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Its purpose lies 
in honoring the bond between horsegirls 
and humanity.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Between horsegirls and humans...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. And during the Goshiki Shuntaisai 
two years from now, 
five sacred rites shall be officiated.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Namely—...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The horsegirl rites, to be recounted for 
ten thousand generations.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
First: "Yabusame." 
The rite of the bowstring piercing 
darkness, ringing with evil-dispelling 
tone.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Second: "Sacred Flag Contest." 
The rite of battle fought by valiant 
warriors in Soma.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Third: "Soaring Gallop." 
The magnificent and brave rite of leaping 
over surging waves.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fourth: "Great Hauling Palanquin." 
The rite of hauling the great shrine 
palanquin to pray for bounty and health.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fifth: "Dedicatory Dance." 
The final rite wishing for our sacred 
bonds to flourish.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Should these five be brought to 
fulfillment, 
the prayers of horsegirls shall surely 
reach their destination.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Any prayer at all?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Yes. No matter what it may be.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And those who serve as the core of each 
program, leading all others, 
are known in the Goshiki Shuntaisai as... 
"Divine Steeds."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could the reason you called us here 
be...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Conclusion! I wish to appoint all of you 
gathered here 
as the Divine Steeds who will lead each 
sacred rite!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We're... the leaders...! 
Of rites so deeply important to 
horsegirls...?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Therefore.

text_block_list.name: Azuma & Director
text_block_list.text:
—We humbly ask for your aid. 
—We humbly ask for your aid.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! Wh-What're ya doin' bowing like 
that?! Please lift yer heads!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai begins. 
We intend to arrange the schedule with 
utmost care 
to ensure your upcoming races remain 
unaffected.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, practicing for the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai 
will undoubtedly assist in honing your 
running capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: And I, too—...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Lady Mayano Top Gun. 
May I offer you a chair?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Your legs feel a slight, pricking 
discomfort, do they not?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ! H-How'd you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in the discerning eye and 
knowledge 
I have cultivated over many years.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Those are early symptoms of sore shins, a 
condition 
unique to horsegirls during their growth 
stages. 
Allow me to instruct you on how to 
alleviate it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! My, my... You seem quite 
knowledgeable, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
As for the programs we wish each of you to 
lead: 
Lady Daiwa Scarlet shall take "Yabusame," 
and Lady Blast Onepiece shall take 
"Soaring Gallop."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Lady No Reason shall take the "Sacred 
Banner Skirmish," 
Lady Yukino Bijin shall take the "Great 
Hauling Palanquin," 
and Lady Mayano Top Gun shall take the 
"Dedicatory Dance."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! Leave that duty to me!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Boo too, Boo too! 
I'm gonna do my very best for humans and 
horsegirls alike!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! I shall contact everyone again 
shortly. 
Dismissed!

And with that, the horsegirls tasked with 
the role of Divine Steeds 
began trickling out of the director's 
office. 
Seeing them off—
choice_data_list: (Wait, why was I called here, though?)
(Wait, why was I called here, though?)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. 
Please wait a moment, Trainer. 
Lady <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
From the beginning, you two are the only 
pair 
summoned together as horsegirl and 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To the two of you, I have an even 
weightier 
request to make.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The role I wish to ask of you, Lady <chrname>, 
is that of the "High Overseer Steed."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The superior who brings together all the 
Divine Steeds— 
call it the "leader of all leaders," if 
you will.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And to Trainer, her trusted partner, 
I ask that you serve as the supporting 
aide 
to both the Divine Steeds and the High 
Overseer Steed.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
One who attends to them, coordinates their 
efforts, and illuminates their path. 
...Those involved in the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai sometimes 
refer to such a person as the "Bridle 
Holder."

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...And indeed, this High Overseer Steed 
and Bridle Holder 
shall be the cornerstones of the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.
choice_data_list: Lady <chrname> and I are the cornerstones...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the standard Shuntaisai, the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai 
is a festival that binds horsegirls and 
humans together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Without humans, 
there can be no Goshiki Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And likewise, without 
horsegirls............

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Lady <chrname>. 
Through the Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
I implore you: please safeguard the future 
of horsegirls.
choice_data_list:
The future of horsegirls... together, 
we'll protect it.

The future of horsegirls... together, 
we'll protect it.

text_block_list.text:
...I recall that night at the festival. 
The desire to be there for the Umamusume, 
too. 
Everything.

Just then, something touched the back of 
my hand. 
I turn and make eye contact with <chrname> beside 
me.

...It seems she had already made up 
her mind before I did.

And so, looking ahead to the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai two years from now, 
<chrname> and I 
took on this monumental duty.
